content.text:
I've written the whole dashboard into `index.html`. I took screenshots in headless Chrome at 1440px and at 390px and fixed the problems they showed. I didn't click through the hover, sorting, channel switch or search in a real browser, so those are untested.

**Design choices**
- **Colours:** the background is a cool sage grey, the colour of unroasted beans, with espresso-brown text. The two chart channels are kestrel slate blue (Online) and roast ochre (Cafés). That colour pair passed the colour-blindness and contrast checks.
- **Type:** Archivo, with even-width figures so numbers line up in columns. Big Shoulders Stencil is used only on the green coffee section.
- **Opening:** the page starts with a written summary instead of a big number: "October revenue reached $184,320, up 6.4% on September…". Under it is a reorder alert for Brazil Cerrado (3 days left) and Ethiopia Guji (6 days), linked to the inventory section.
- **The one decorative element:** green coffee inventory is drawn as jute sacks. Each has the origin stencilled on it, a gauge from 0 to 28 days with a tick at the 7-day reorder point, and a red "Reorder now" tag on anything under 7 days. The sacks are ordered lowest stock first.

**Sections**
- **Navigation:** a left rail with the company name and all seven items. Overview is marked as the current page. Below 860px it becomes a menu button that opens a drawer, which closes with Escape or by tapping outside it.
- **Top bar:** title, period, search field and Mara Kim with "MK" initials. The search works: it filters recent orders and top products, and shows a "clear the search" option when nothing matches.
- **KPI cards:** all five sit in one band. The refund rate's −0.3 pts is shown in green with "lower is better".
- **Revenue chart:** stacked bars for the 12 months, with a switch between All channels, Online and Cafés. It shows exact values on hover, tap, or left and right arrow keys, and has a "Show chart data as a table" option.
- **Revenue by category:** a sorted bar list in one neutral colour.
- **Café table:** sortable by any column header. Riverside is shown with "Opened June 2026" under its name.
- **Order statuses:** Shipped is a solid dark pill with a truck icon, Paid is green with a check, Pending is a dashed outline with a clock, and Refunded is red with a return arrow. The refunded total is also struck through.

**Mobile (390px)**
- The KPIs go to two columns.
- Recent orders turn into stacked rows so the status stays visible.
- The café table scrolls sideways, with an edge shadow showing there are more columns.

Everything uses only the figures from your brief. The icons and logo are inline SVG, and the only things loaded from outside are the two Google Fonts. Motion is limited to the bars rising once when the page loads, and that is switched off when the system's reduced-motion setting is on.
